user.title: Aiphone IXG credentials
user.description: Paste the complete contents of the IXG bridge's `.state/credentials.json` file. The bridge must have already registered a virtual app slot. No MQTT broker is required; Home Assistant connects to the Aiphone cloud directly.

error.missing_fields: The credentials file is missing one or more required fields.
error.invalid_certificate: The client certificate is not a PEM certificate.
error.invalid_private_key: The private key is not a PEM private key.
error.missing_receive_topics: The credentials file has no rcv_topics.
error.room_list_missing: room_client_ids is missing. Run `npm run refresh-room` in the bridge and paste the updated credentials.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This IXG app slot is already configured.
